name: RIYA TRAVELS
summary: RIYA Travels and Tours Pvt Ltd Group is committed to sustainable procurement that reduces environmental impact, supports ethical sourcing, and strengthens supply chain transparency. The policy emphasizes eco-friendly purchasing, supplier accountability, waste reduction, and continuous improvement across its global operations.

declaration.preface: At Riya Travels and Tours Pvt ltd (Group), we recognize our responsibility to minimize our environmental impact and contribute to a sustainable future. As a leading travel service provider, we acknowledge that the tourism and travel industry plays a crucial role in environmental conservation. Our commitment to environmental stewardship is rooted in responsible business practices that aim to reduce carbon emissions, minimize waste, and promote eco-friendly travel solutions. Through sustainable procurement, energy-efficient operations, and awareness initiatives, we strive to make a positive impact on the environment while delivering high-quality services to our customers. This policy outlines our approach to integrating environmental sustainability into our business practices, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, and fostering a culture of environmental responsibility within our organization and among our stakeholders.
declaration.declaration: Riya Travels is committed to environmental stewardship by integrating sustainable practices into our operations. We strive to minimize our ecological footprint, promote responsible tourism, and support environmental conservation. Through innovation and collaboration, we aim to reduce waste, enhance resource efficiency, and contribute to a greener future.
declaration.scope: This Environmental Stewardship Policy is applicable across all operations, business functions, and services of Riya Travel and Tours (India) Pvt Ltd (Group), covering all global locations, including corporate offices, registered offices, branch locations, subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associated supply chain activities. It applies to all employees, workers, contractors, and stakeholders connected to Riya Travel and Tours (India) Pvt Ltd (Group), whether directly or indirectly, and mandates strict adherence and accountability at every level.

Sustainable Waste Practices: Minimizing waste generation and its environmental impact is a key priority.
The company aims to phase out single-use plastics and use reusable office supplies to reduce plastic waste.
Energy Efficiency and Carbon Reduction: Lowering energy consumption and reducing greenhouse gas emissions remains a central focus.
Water Stewardship and Efficiency: Responsible water use and conservation efforts are actively promoted.
Customer health and Safety: Customer health and safety are prioritized in all aspects of our operations.
Environmental Service and Advocacy: Advocating for environmental sustainability and promoting eco-friendly practices is integral to our mission.

targets.target: Ensure 100% workforce participation in waste reduction training
Achieve 15% overall Scope 1-2-3 GHG emission reduction
Ensure 100% workforce engagement in energy conservation training
Eliminate plastic bottled water in all offices
Ensure 100% compliance with global safety guidelines
Aim for zero major safety incidents
Increase customer participation in eco-friendly travel by 50%
Ensure 100% of stakeholders are educated and comply with eco-friendly standards

responsibilities.duty: Responsible for overseeing and review the implementation of the policy.
Ensuring compliance with environmental regulations, and promoting continuous improvement.
Provides strategic direction, allocates necessary resources.
Integrates sustainability into corporate decision-making to drive long-term environmental responsibility.
Expected to adopt eco-friendly workplace practices, reduce waste, conserve energy and water.
Ensures that all purchases prioritize sustainability by selecting eco-friendly, ethically sourced products and working with responsible suppliers.
Implements and maintains energy-efficient operations, waste segregation systems, and water conservation measures across all office locations.

policy.monitoring:
The Sustainability Officer will submit quarterly reports to senior management on policy implementation, progress, and key environmental performance indicators.

Department heads will provide updates on sustainability initiatives, challenges, and corrective actions taken.

Regular audits will be conducted to ensure adherence to environmental regulations and corporate sustainability commitments.

Non-compliance incidents will be documented, investigated, and addressed through corrective measures.

An annual sustainability report will be published to communicate the company’s environmental impact, progress on targets, and future commitments.

Reports will be shared with relevant stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, business partners, and customers.

A reporting mechanism will be established for employees and stakeholders to raise concerns or suggest improvements related to environmental practices.

Feedback will be reviewed regularly to enhance the effectiveness of the policy.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Sustainability Officer will review this policy every year or when needed to ensure its relevance and effectiveness. In collaboration with senior management and key stakeholders, they will evaluate progress, assess compliance, and identify areas for improvement. Adjustments will be made based on regulatory updates, operational changes, and sustainability advancements to maintain alignment with best practices and corporate goals.
